# Circle C Contracting, LLC

> Excavation and utility contractor based in Onawa, Iowa, serving Monona County and surrounding communities in western Iowa.

Circle C Contracting installs and repairs water and sewer lines, septic systems, and underground utilities, and handles trenching, site preparation, land clearing, and emergency utility repairs for residential, farm, and small commercial projects.
